title: Senior Product Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY

This highly cross-functional role serves as a central hub for synthesizing market, customer, clinical, operational, financial, technology, regulatory, and competitive inputs into a clear, actionable product roadmap that guides organizational priorities and execution. The Product Management team is accountable for defining customer-centric portfolio direction, establishing data-driven prioritization and investment recommendations, monitoring product performance, and driving alignment with Sales, Market Access, R&D, Operations, Technology, Medical Affairs, Finance, Legal, and Executive Leadership. The Sr. Product Manager will ensure the portfolio is strategically differentiated, financially sustainable, operationally feasible, easy to sell internally, and easy for customers to understand externally.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Product Roadmap Strategy & Governance: Maintain a clear, well-structured product roadmap that serves as the single source of truth for rare disease product direction, execution priorities, and cross-functional alignment.

• Market & Customer Insight: Incorporate structured external inputs from customers, providers, commercial teams, competition, market access, technology trends, clinical landscape, and regulatory environment to identify market opportunities, unmet needs, and portfolio gaps. Synthesize these insights into the product roadmap.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Sales, Market Access, R&D, Operations, Technology, Medical Affairs, Finance, Legal, Quality, and Client Services, to align roadmap priorities, execution requirements, resourcing, and stakeholder expectations.

• Prioritization & Business Case Development: Develop data-supported business cases and ROI justification including strategic fit, business impact, feasibility, revenue, profitability, market share, competitive advantage, technical complexity, operational readiness, regulatory considerations, and resource requirements.

• Product Definition: Own Market Requirements Documents (MRDs), define target segments, value propositions, use cases, product features, workflows, user experience requirements, pricing inputs, and clinical, financial, adoption, operational, and quality success metrics.

• Product Performance Management: Monitor performance of on-market products, including volume, revenue, ASP, profitability, adoption, operational performance, quality indicators, and sustainability; proactively identify risks, trends and underperformance and drive corrective action plans with clear owners, timelines, and measurable progress tracking.

• Product Improvements & Lifecycle Management: Manage enhancements, iterations, releases, and lifecycle improvements for existing products; drive continuous improvement based on customer feedback, product performance, market changes, operational needs, reimbursement dynamics, and post-launch results.

• Commercialization Support: Support go-to-market readiness by partnering with Sales, Marketing, Client Services, Medical Affairs, Laboratory Operations, Clinical Operations, and other stakeholders on launch planning, training, materials, workflows, messaging, sales enablement, and commercial execution.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, genetics, bioinformatics, healthcare, business, or a related field.

• 10 years of experience in product management in diagnostics, genomics, or related field

• Experience with lifecycle management of on-market products and commercial product launches

• Experience leading cross-functional teams or initiatives in a clinical, healthcare, laboratory, or regulated environment.

• Strong ability to translate clinical, market, customer, and partner insights into practical product requirements, prioritized execution plans, and measurable business outcomes.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Preferred:

• Advanced degree such as MS, PhD, MBA, or genetic counseling degree.

• Experience with whole exome or whole genome sequencing or related technologies

• Experience with geneticists/genetic counselors, neurologists, and/or developmental pediatricians preferred

COMPETENCIES

• Strategic Thinking: Ability to evaluate market trends, customer needs, business goals, competitive dynamics, and portfolio performance to define a compelling product vision, roadmap, and investment priorities aligned to company strategy.

• Technical & Clinical Fluency: Strong understanding of genetic testing, genomic technologies, clinical workflows, data and analytics concepts, and regulated product development processes; ability to communicate effectively with R&D, Technology, Laboratory Operations, Medical Affairs, and other technical stakeholders.

• Communication & Cross-Functional Leadership: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex clinical, technical, market, and business requirements for executive, commercial, operational, and technical audiences; demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and secure stakeholder alignment.

• Prioritization & Execution Discipline: Ability to prioritize initiatives using data, customer feedback, strategic fit, business impact, feasibility, and resource considerations; demonstrated capability to drive roadmap execution, product delivery, launch readiness, and continuous improvement with clear ownership and accountability.

• Customer & Market Insight: Deep customer orientation with the ability to gather and synthesize insights from providers, customers, sales teams, market access, competitive intelligence, user research, and performance data to anticipate needs and ensure products deliver meaningful clinical and business value.

• Analytical & Data-Driven Decision Making: Strong analytical skills and comfort using product, financial, commercial, operational, quality, and customer metrics to assess performance, identify risks and opportunities, develop business cases, and guide product decisions.

• Adaptability & Continuous Learning: Curiosity, flexibility, and commitment to continuous improvement in response to evolving customer expectations, reimbursement dynamics, regulatory requirements, emerging technologies, and changes in the rare disease genetic testing market.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

• Location: Remote with approximately quarterly travel required.

• Work is primarily performed in a professional office or remote work environment using standard computer and communication equipment.

• Requires prolonged periods of sitting, computer use, virtual meetings, reading, writing, and verbal communication.

• May require occasional travel for customer, partner, conference, or internal business meetings.

• May require interaction with clinical laboratory, commercial, operational, and quality teams; any laboratory access must comply with applicable company policies, safety procedures, and regulatory requirements.

EEO STATEMENT

Baylor Genetics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, veteran status, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: QUALITY CONTROL TECHNICIAN
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Quality Technician is responsible for performing inspections, tests, and quality checks throughout the production process for structural and architectural precast concrete products. This role ensures all products meet PCI, company, and project specifications prior to shipment. The Quality Technician works closely with production and quality teams to identify issues, maintain documentation, and support continuous improvement in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

SAFETY IS OUR HIGHEST PRIORITY. Safety is our highest priority. We believe a safe workplace is built on mutual respect, care, and accountability. Every team member is empowered and expected to follow safety practices, look out for one another, and speak up about potential risks. Together, we create an environment where everyone goes home safely each day.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?

At Wells, you’re part of a team that takes pride in building something that lasts. Whether you’re in operations, a manufacturing facility, or out in the field, your work plays a direct role in creating quality structures that support our communities. We value hard work, reliability, and teamwork because getting the job done right requires teamwork. With a strong focus on safety, collaboration, and ingenuity, we create an environment where you can build your experience, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

WHAT WE OFFER
Wells provides a competitive benefits package designed to support employees’ health, financial well-being, and work-life balance. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, company-paid disability and life insurance, wellness incentives, paid holidays, PTO, flexible spending accounts, HSA options, a 401(k) with profit sharing, access to Nice Healthcare, employee assistance resources, pet insurance, and additional voluntary coverage such as critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity plans.

  • Health and family care leave is available to both union and non-union employees.
  • Union employee benefits are provided through separate collective bargaining agreements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Perform pre-pour, post-pour, and final inspections on precast concrete products
  • Identify and report non-conforming materials, equipment, or test results to QC leadership
  • Ensure products meet PCI, company, and project specifications prior to shipment
  • Maintain accurate quality control documentation in compliance with required standards
  • Read and interpret blueprints, production drawings, and project specifications
  • Use testing tools and equipment such as slump cones, air meters, scales, ovens, and sieves
  • Conduct accurate measurements using tape measures and other precision tools
  • Perform basic material testing and analysis to support quality assurance processes
  • Maintain clean, safe, and organized work areas while following all safety procedures
  • Collaborate with production, engineering, and QC teams to resolve quality issues

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented and safety-focused individual with a strong interest in quality control and precast manufacturing. They are dependable, precise, and comfortable working in a fast-paced production environment where accuracy and consistency are critical. This individual takes pride in their work, communicates effectively with production teams, and is committed to ensuring high-quality, compliant finished products.

IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • 2+ years of quality control experience in heavy industrial, concrete, or construction environments
  • ACI or PCI certification preferred
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality standards
  • Basic math skills and computer proficiency (Microsoft Office)
  • Ability to use measuring and testing tools accurately
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment
  • Strong understanding of safety practices and procedures

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to perform physically demanding work, including lifting up to 50 lbs occasionally and frequent bending, climbing, kneeling, twisting, squatting, crawling, and repetitive hand/arm use
  • Capable of standing, walking, and moving throughout the facility for extended shifts of up to 12 hours
  • Comfortable working at heights using ladders, scaffolding, swing stages, and man lifts frequently
  • Ability to work safely in a production or field environment with moderate to high exposure to safety risks and hazards
  • Willingness to work in varying environmental conditions, including wet, hot, humid, and cold weather, and outdoors (Depending on location)
  • Ability to wear all required PPE, including but not limited to safety boots, safety glasses, hearing protection, high visibility vest, hard hat, and other PPE as required by the task, department, or work area.

This profile summarizes key duties and expectations but does not list every possible job task. Employees must follow all job-related instructions and duties assigned by supervisors.

Wells is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities. Wells participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I-9 Form information to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

  • Strong understanding of utility equipment operation, maintenance, reliability and troubleshooting.

  • Experience working within a GMP-regulated environment is essential; pharmaceutical industry experience is not mandatory.

title: Applied Machine Learning Engineer, EMEA
description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role:

As an Applied Machine Learning Engineer, you are the technical owner of a customer engagement. This is what is globally known as the Forward Deployed Engineer role; at Fireworks in EMEA it carries the AMLE title. You embed with a small number of accounts, work in their environment, and own whatever stands between them and production on Fireworks: the model, the serving path, the integration, the performance. You scope the work before signature and deliver what you scoped. Depth over breadth: few accounts, owned end to end.

What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You will be evaluated on this directly in the interview process, and strength here can outweigh gaps elsewhere in your background.

Four Spikes:

  1. Software engineering. You ship production systems and are comfortable dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or a customer environment with a deadline. Backend and systems depth, strong Python plus at least one systems language, and fluency with AI-assisted and agentic engineering as a core part of how you build.

  2. Machine learning. You take open models and make them better on a customer's task: SFT, LoRA and other parameter-efficient methods, reinforcement learning (RLHF, RLVR), distillation. Just as important, you design evaluations that reflect the real task and let them drive training decisions, and you know when fine-tuning is not the answer.

  3. Infrastructure and performance. You know your GPUs: memory bandwidth, kernels, parallelism, what utilization numbers actually mean. Serving and inference optimization: quantization, speculative decoding, batching, KV cache behavior, latency vs throughput tradeoffs, multi-GPU and multi-node serving, capacity planning. You can take a deployment that works and make it fast and economical, and reason about where the bottleneck is before touching a profiler.

  4. Customer engagement. You want to be in the room. The point of this role is creating specialized intelligence for each customer: the best model for their task, their data, their constraints. That takes real interest in the customer's problem, not just the technical one. Exceptional here looks like founder energy with customers; the floor is genuine appetite to embed, explain, and own outcomes with them.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Engagements: Take customer deployments from scoping through production, as the single accountable technical owner.

  • Embed: Work directly inside customer teams; understand their domain, data, and constraints well enough to make decisions they trust.

  • Train and Tune: Run fine-tuning and post-training work where the engagement needs it, from data to evaluation to a model serving in production.

  • Optimize: Drive serving performance and cost on Fireworks: model choice, deployment shape, and inference optimization.

  • Scope Honestly: Assess what is achievable before we commit, and inherit what you scope.

  • Product Signal: Feed what customers need back to product and engineering, with enough precision to be actionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Spikes in two or all three areas.

  • For the ML spike: formal training (PhD, PhD in progress, or a strong MSc) and experience post-training LLMs specifically.

  • For the infrastructure spike: experience with GPU infrastructure, distributed serving, or inference engines.

  • Founder or founding engineer experience.

  • Experience in a startup or fast-paced environment.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

title: Junior Electronics Engineer
description:
Junior Electronics Engineer (Production & Projects)

Department / Function: Hardware Engineering – Production & Projects

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 0–2 years – recent graduates with strong fundamentals are welcome

Job Overview

As a Junior Electronics Engineer within the Production & Project steam, you will support the assembly, testing, and maintenance of electronic products for fare collection, payment, and transit applications — including validators, fare gates, ticket vending machines, and AFC infrastructure. This is a hands-on, entry-level role where you will learn alongside experienced engineers and build the practical skills to grow into a full Electronics Engineer.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in the assembly, testing, and inspection of electronic boards and finished devices.

• Execute functional and production test procedures under supervision and accurately record results.

• Perform basic troubleshooting and repair of electronic assemblies, including soldering and rework.

• Support firmware flashing, device programming, and functional verification.

• Help maintain lab and production equipment, ESD discipline, and component inventory.

• Document test results, maintenance logs, and observations for engineering review.

• Support senior engineers during integration, commissioning, and project deployment.

Required Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electronics/Electrical Engineering ora related technical field.

• Experience: 0–2 years; recent graduates with strong fundamentals and relevant project/internship experience are encouraged to apply.

◦ Good understanding of analog and digital electronics and circuit fundamentals.

◦ Soldering ability and willingness to develop rework skills.

◦ Familiarity with lab instruments (oscilloscope, meters) and reading schematics/BOMs.

◦ Awareness of common interfaces such as UART, USB, SPI, and I2C.

◦ Strong PC skills (Windows/Linux) and good documentation habits.

◦ Familiarity with electronic and PCB design software specifically Altium Designer.

◦ Good communication skills in English.

• Problem-Solving Skills: A logical, methodical approach to troubleshooting and a willingness to learn.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on Experience: Internship or academic project experience with embedded hardware or PCB assembly.

• Training: soldering or rework training.

• Industry Knowledge: Exposure to AFC, transit, or payment systems.

Eagerness to learn, attention to detail, reliability, and a team

title: Endoscopy Technician - PRN
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

An Endoscopy Technician performs technical responsibilities relative to treatment and care of the Endoscopy patient with the instrumentation utilized in that treatment. Monitors PAR levels of all instrumentation and supplies. The Endoscopy Technician prepares, assembles, and organizes the work environment, equipment and supplies necessary to perform diagnostic and/or therapeutic procedures. Participates in staff meetings and performance improvement activities. Works under the direction and supervision of a Registered Nurse.

Job duties include but are not limited to:

  • Effectively organizing time, equipment, supplies to ensure that needed items are readily available in the assigned procedure room.
  • Uses equipment accurately to ensure no equipment is broken or instruments lost.
  • Provides comfort and reassurance to the patient and promotes privacy and dignity.
  • Assists the physician during GI procedures and handles specimens.
  • Assists in cleaning and high-level disinfection of equipment, utilizing manual processes and an automated endoscope re-processor (AER).
  • Assists in the cleaning and turnover of the procedure room between cases.
  • Maintains current knowledge of endoscopic procedures.
  • Performs other duties as needed.

title: Technical Program Manager, Thermal & Mechanical Engineering
description:
THE ROLE:

You will lead thermal, mechanical and advanced board-assembly development programs from requirements through engineering builds, qualification, manufacturing release and production ramp. You will connect package, board, cooling and chassis integration to make sure engineering and supplier deliverables support the product schedule. The role includes regional travel to supplier sites and engineering builds.

THE PERSON:

You are an individual contributor who drives decisions across global engineering, manufacturing and supplier teams without direct authority. You have enough technical depth to challenge assumptions and assess risk, while engineering owners keep design approval. You communicate clearly with engineers and executives alike.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Define program scope, milestones, owners and acceptance criteria. Build integrated schedules and manage critical paths, resources and budgets.
  • Coordinate package, board and chassis interfaces, including thermal, power, mechanical and assembly requirements, and assess the impact of design changes.
  • Lead execution reviews with cooling suppliers, CMs, ODMs and OSATs. Track specifications, samples, tooling, capacity, quality and recovery actions.
  • Plan engineering and validation builds, and drive evidence-based entry and exit decisions at each milestone.
  • Coordinate program deliverables for advanced SMT and large BGA assembly, including process windows, warpage mitigation, defect reduction, edge bond/underfill and BGA rework, with the responsible engineers.
  • Manage risks, issues, dependencies and engineering changes. Present recovery options with schedule, cost and qualification impact to decision-makers.
  • Drive DFM/DFA reviews, release documentation, manufacturing handover, ramp issue closure and lessons learned.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Substantial experience in thermal/mechanical hardware, electronic packaging or electronics NPI, including leading complex cross-functional technical programs.
  • Proven delivery from engineering development through qualification and production ramp.
  • Working knowledge of SMT processes and large BGA assembly challenges (warpage, coplanarity, solder-joint integrity) is advantageous.
  • Understanding of the package-to-system heat path, TIMs, tolerance stack-ups, shock/vibration and board-level reliability qualification is advantageous.
  • Experience managing cooling suppliers, CMs, ODMs or OSATs, preferably in the Asia-Pacific region is advantageous.
  • Experience with DOE, root-cause analysis (8D, FMEA) and phase-gate program management is advantageous.
  • Proficient in English, technical writing and executive communication skills.
  • High-performance computing, GPU or server programs; liquid/air cooling products; PMP or equivalent; Power BI, SQL or Python is advantageous.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Materials, Manufacturing, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered.

LOCATION:

Singapore

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Together, We Can Make A Significant Impact – Position Overview

We are looking for a proactive and experienced Senior Business Analyst to lead requirements discovery, analysis, validation, and delivery support for complex or cross-functional digital initiatives.

This role is expected to be approximately 70% execution-focused and 30% strategic, requiring the candidate to work hands-on with stakeholders, product teams, designers, engineering teams, operations, and business users, while also shaping recommendations that influence product direction, process improvements, and long-term decision-making.

The Senior Business Analyst should be comfortable working with ambiguity, challenging assumptions, navigating conflicting stakeholder needs, and translating complex business and technical requirements into structured, actionable specifications. The role also requires strong ownership in ensuring that solutions are validated, business outcomes are met, and junior Business Analysts are guided in effective requirements and stakeholder management practices.

Be Part of Our Success – Key Responsibilities

Requirements Discovery & Problem Framing

• Lead requirements discovery for complex or cross-functional initiatives through stakeholder interviews, workshops, walkthroughs, and desk research.

• Manage stakeholder expectations and challenge assumptions to uncover the real problem before jumping to solutions.

• Translate ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable, and testable business and technical requirements.

• Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, use cases, business rules, service journeys, and technical specifications that guide delivery teams.

• Architect requirements that address cross-functional challenges across business, operations, product, design, and engineering teams.

• Navigate conflicting requirements between stakeholder groups and facilitate consensus without defaulting to the loudest voice or existing way of doing things.

Business Process Analysis & Structural Improvement

• Assess current-state business processes across multiple work units and identify inefficiencies, gaps, pain points, and improvement opportunities.

• Propose structural improvements that deliver measurable impact to users and the business, rather than only incremental fixes.

• Develop future-state process flows, service journeys, and operating considerations to support solution design and implementation.

• Use process maps, journey maps, and visual artefacts to communicate problems, dependencies, opportunities, and proposed improvements.

• Actively identify and eliminate process friction within the team by proposing, trialling, and scaling better ways of working.

Data Analysis & Strategic Recommendations

• Use advanced data analysis to identify trends, uncover insights, predict outcomes, and support evidence-based decision-making.

• Translate data findings, user feedback, and operational observations into strategic recommendations that shape product direction and prioritisation.

• Work with stakeholders to define success measures, validate business impact, and assess whether proposed changes achieve intended outcomes.

• Use tools such as SQL, Excel, dashboards, and data visualisation software to analyse and present findings clearly.

• Provide recommendations that support both immediate delivery needs and longer-term product or business improvements.

Experimentation, Prototyping & Validation

• Design and run experiments, prototypes, pilots, and proof-of-concepts to validate ideas early and build evidence before committing to large-scale delivery.

• Work with Product Managers, UX Designers, Business Architects, Solution Architects, and engineering teams to test assumptions and refine solution options.

• Apply ideation and prototyping techniques to frame and solve the right problems.

• Synthesise user research, workshop insights, data findings, and prototype feedback into practical recommendations.

• Encourage rapid experimentation and evidence-based validation over prolonged debate.

Testing, Quality & Delivery Support

• Lead testing and validation efforts for medium-to-large initiatives to ensure implemented solutions meet business needs and function as intended.

• Own quality outcomes by ensuring requirements are clear, traceable, testable, and validated through to deployment.

• Support UAT planning, test scenario preparation, defect clarification, issue triage, and go-live readiness.

• Work with delivery and engineering teams to resolve issues through to closure.

• Ensure delivered solutions are aligned with business objectives, user needs, operational requirements, and compliance expectations.

Project Planning & Delivery Management Support

• Drive project planning and delivery management activities for medium-to-large scale initiatives.

• Manage scope, dependencies, priorities, risks, issues, and resources to keep delivery on track.

• Contribute to sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, release planning, and delivery tracking.

• Work closely with Product Managers, Delivery Managers, engineering teams, and stakeholders to maintain alignment on delivery outcomes and commitments.

• Communicate delivery risks, trade-offs, assumptions, and decisions clearly to stakeholders and project teams.

Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Facilitate workshops and working sessions that generate actionable insights and drive user-focused service enhancements.

• Engage stakeholders across business, product, design, engineering, operations, and governance teams to ensure alignment on priorities and outcomes.

• Facilitate technical and business alignment when requirements, priorities, or constraints differ across stakeholder groups.

• Use strong storytelling, communication, and visualisation skills to present findings, recommendations, and trade-offs effectively.

• Foster open and inclusive discussions through active listening, adaptability, and collaboration.

Coaching & Continuous Improvement

• Coach junior Business Analysts on effective requirements practices, stakeholder management, facilitation, documentation, and ownership mindset.

• Promote a culture of curiosity, accountability, continuous improvement, and evidence-based decision-making.

• Encourage constructive challenge and “farming for dissent” to improve current approaches and avoid groupthink.

• Identify practices that work well and support scaling them across teams where appropriate.

• Share knowledge, templates, lessons learnt, and practical ways of working to uplift the overall BA capability.


Requirements

Qualities We Value

• Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Operations Management, or a related discipline.

• Alternatively, significant professional experience and demonstrated skills in business analysis, operations management, Agile/Scrum methodologies, or related areas may be considered in lieu of formal education.

• Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience in business analysis, product delivery, operations, digital transformation, or related roles.

• Strong user-centred analysis, stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and process modelling skills.

• Strong experience in requirements discovery, requirements architecture, user story writing, acceptance criteria definition, process mapping, and documentation.

• Ability to translate ambiguous or complex business needs into structured, actionable, and testable requirements.

• Ability to assess complex situations, identify underlying problems, and devise effective solutions.

• Experience facilitating interactive design thinking workshops that promote empathy, creativity, collaboration, and shared understanding.

• Familiarity with ideation, prototyping, pilot, and proof-of-concept techniques to frame and validate the right problems.

• Ability to synthesise user research, stakeholder inputs, and data findings into clear service journey maps, pain points, opportunities, and recommendations.

• Strong collaboration skills with the ability to align cross-functional teams across product, design, engineering, operations, and business.

• Excellent communication and visualisation skills for storytelling and presenting findings effectively.

• Proficiency with tools to create visual maps, workshop artefacts, requirements documentation, and process models.

• Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Excel, Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, SQL, and data visualisation software.

• Strong active listening, adaptability, teamwork, curiosity, and openness to feedback.

• Ability to lead workshops that generate actionable insights and drive user-focused service enhancements.

• Capability to address challenges creatively and implement practical solutions.

• Significant experience and knowledge in the respective domain would be preferred.

title: Business System Analyst
description:

Service Delivery Manager

Job Overview

We are seeking a Business System Analyst to support the implementation of treasury back-office system. The role involves working closely with the Lead Business Analyst, Treasury Operations users, Head Office (HO), Implementation team, and Other related department users to deliver system implementation, testing, and data migration activities.

The successful candidate will be responsible for understanding existing business processes, analysing requirements, conducting fit-gap assessments between current systems and To-Be system, preparing functional documentation, supporting user acceptance testing(UAT), and coordinating data migration activities.

The role covers Foreign Exchange (FX), Money Market (MM), and Securities in bank back-office operations, with a focus on business requirements, system functionality, operational workflows, data integrity, and implementation readiness.

Responsibilities and Duties

Business Analysis & Requirements Management

  • Support the Lead Business Analyst in the implementation of a Treasury Back-Office system for an international bank.
  • Work closely with Treasury Operations, Head Office (HO), internal IT teams and other stakeholders to gather, clarify and document business requirements.
  • Analyse existing business processes and perform fit-gap assessments for FX, Money Market and Securities products, including Forwards, Swaps, NDFs, MM Lending/Borrowing, Bonds and Bills.
  • Analyse product configurations, reference/static data and operational parameters.
  • Prepare and maintain BRDs, functional specifications, requirement traceability documents and issue logs.

Functional Analysis & System Integration

  • Investigate functional issues by analysing business scenarios, transaction data, system outputs and interface information.
  • Document findings and coordinate with business users, HO and IT teams to resolve functional and technical queries.
  • Analyse system interfaces, data mappings and integrations.
  • Review interface specifications, field-level mappings, message formats and processing rules to ensure alignment with business requirements.

Testing & Defect Management

  • Prepare test scenarios, test cases, expected results and test data for system testing and User Acceptance Testing(UAT).
  • Conduct and support UAT activities with business users.
  • Log, track and retest defects, and coordinate their resolution with business and technology teams.
  • Monitor testing progress and support the completion of testing evidence and sign-off documentation

DataMigration & Validation

  • Support data migration activities, including data review, validation, reconciliation and source-to-target comparison.
  • Participate in migration rehearsals across test and production environments.
  • Validatemigrated transactions, balances, reference data and reports.
  • Perform data analysis and investigation using SQL and Excel to identify discrepancies and support resolution.

Project Coordination & Documentation

  • Track project issues, risks, actions, dependencies and overall delivery progress.
  • Prepare project documentation, status updates and supporting evidence required for review and sign-off.
  • Coordinate across business, Head Office and technology teams to ensure project activities and deliverables remain on track.

Qualifications

Must Have

  • 5–7 years of experience in a Business Analyst / System Analyst role, preferably within the banking or financial services industry.
  • Strong experience in requirements gathering, business process analysis, functional documentation and stakeholder management.
  • Hands-on experience in system testing and UAT, including preparation of test scenarios, test cases, expected results and defect tracking.
  • Experience supporting data migration activities, including data validation, reconciliation and source-to-target comparison.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured and investigative approach.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into clear, functional and testable specifications.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly in relation to data accuracy and system outputs.
  • Effective stakeholder communication and coordination skills across business and technology teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple deliverables, track issues and risks, and meet project milestones.
  • Strong ownership of assigned requirements, testing and migration activities.

Preferred / Advantageous

  • Prior experience in Treasury, Treasury Operations or Treasury related Back-Office system implementation.
  • Knowledge of Treasury products such as FX, Forwards, Swaps, NDFs, Money Market Lending/Borrowing, Bonds and Bills.
  • Experience working on banking system implementation or transformation projects.
  • Experience with system interfaces, data mappings, message formats and system integrations.
  • Hands-on experience using SQL and Excel for data analysis, investigation and reconciliation.
  • Experience working with Head Office, regional stakeholders or cross-border project teams.
  • Exposure to migration rehearsals, production cutover activities and post-migration validation.

title: Residential Cleaners
description:
About HomelyCare
HomelyCare is a local home-support services company that was founded by two caregivers who know first-hand how hard it can be to care for a loved one while managing a home. We built HomelyCare to give families the dependable, caring help we once needed ourselves, through elder care, residential cleaning and grocery assistance. We're also proud to create flexible work opportunities for Singaporeans and PRs, so they can earn on their own terms while making a real difference to our ageing community.

About the role
As a Residential Cleaner, you'll help families keep their homes clean, safe and comfortable. Many of our clients are busy caregivers or seniors living at home, so your work makes a real difference to their daily lives. This is a freelance role: you choose the assignments that fit your availability and are paid per assignment.

What you'll do

  • Clean homes thoroughly, including living areas, bedrooms, kitchens and bathrooms
  • Sweep, vacuum and mop floors, and dust furniture and surfaces
  • Clean kitchen surfaces, appliance exteriors and sinks
  • Clean and sanitise toilets, showers and basins
  • Take out rubbish and tidy common areas
  • Change bed linen and do light laundry when requested
  • Follow each client's special instructions, including using their own cleaning equipment and products when they ask
  • Handle clients' belongings with care and respect their privacy
  • Report any damage, safety hazards or concerns to HomelyCare
  • Follow HomelyCare's cleaning guidelines and keep client information confidential

Requirements

  • Experience in residential or commercial cleaning is an advantage
  • Knowledge of safe use of cleaning products and equipment
  • Thorough, careful and attentive to detail
  • Honest, trustworthy and respectful of clients' homes and belongings
  • Reliable, punctual and able to work independently
  • Physically fit for active work, including bending, lifting and standing for long periods
  • Friendly and patient, especially when working in homes with seniors
  • Ability to speak Hokkien, Teochew or Cantonese is an advantage, as some of our senior clients are most comfortable conversing in dialect

What we offer

  • Flexible freelance assignments that work around your schedule
  • Training on HomelyCare's cleaning standards
  • Meaningful work helping families and seniors in the community

title: Project Manager
company: FUTURE ENERGY STORAGE AND SYSTEM INTEGRATION ALLIANCE (FESSIA) LTD.
description:
Role Overview:

The Project Manager will be based in Singapore and will be responsible for the effective coordination, implementation, delivery, monitoring and completion of FESSIA’s policy and other strategic projects. Working closely with the Policy and Country teams, the role will translate FESSIA’s strategy and project objectives into clear workplans and deliverables, coordinate internal and external resources, manage project budgets and risks, and ensure projects are delivered to a high standard, on time and within budget. The role will also support the development of new projects by identifying policy, regulatory and market gaps and helping design practical interventions to address them.

Key Responsibilities:

The Project Manager is responsible for defining project scope, goals and deliverables with the Policy team; planning and implementing projects with Country and Policy Managers; managing project budgets, including monitoring expenditure, variations and donor reporting; ensuring projects deliver agreed results on time and within budget; supporting procurement processes; identifying and managing project risks and changes; and continuously improving project processes, quality and team learning.

Detailed Responsibilities:

1.Project Design and Planning

  • In collaboration with the Policy and Country teams define project scope, objectives, outcomes, deliverables and success measures, aligned with FESSIA’s strategy, donor commitments and agreed project objectives.
  • Develop detailed project plans, including activities, milestones, timelines, dependencies, responsibilities and resource requirements.
  • Work with the Policy team to identify gaps in laws, policies, regulations and market frameworks and translate these into practical project activities and outputs.
  • Establish clear project governance, roles and decision-making processes for each project.

2. Project Delivery and Coordination

  • Liaise with FESSIA Country Managers, Policy Managers and other team members to ensure activities are coordinated, delivered effectively and manage the implementation of projects through to completion, monitoring progress against agreed milestones and deliverables.
  • Coordinate consultants, technical experts, partners and other external resources involved in project delivery.
  • Identify implementation issues and delays early and work with the relevant teams to resolve them.

3. Budget and Financial Management

  • Manage project budgets in accordance with approved budgets, FESSIA financial controls, FESSIA consolidated budgets and donor requirements.
  • Monitor expenditure, commitments and budget utilization and identify potential variances or underspend/overspend risks.
  • Coordinate budget revisions, variations and budget amendment requests where required.
  • Work with Finance and project leads to ensure expenditure is properly authorised, documented and allocated to the correct project and reported on for internal management and donor reporting according to defined project reporting cycle

4. Reporting and Donor Compliance

  • Coordinate timely and accurate internal and external project reporting.
  • Monitor progress against project objectives, outputs, milestones, budgets and donor commitments.
  • Coordinate inputs from Policy, Country and other relevant teams to produce project and donor reports.
  • Ensure project activities and reporting comply with relevant donor requirements and FESSIA policies.

5. Procurement and Contract Administration

  • Support project procurement in accordance with FESSIA’s procurement policy and procedures.
  • Prepare or coordinate scopes of work, procurement documentation and consultant requirements.
  • Administer procurement processes and support the selection and appointment of consultants, contractors and other suppliers.
  • Monitor consultant and supplier deliverables against agreed scopes, timelines and budgets.

6. Project Monitoring, Risk and Change Management

  • Regularly monitor project progress, deliverables, risks (including on a risk-mitigations register), issues and dependencies.
  • Identify changes to project scope, timelines, resources or budgets and assess their potential impact.
  • Implement and manage agreed changes while maintaining alignment with project objectives and donor commitments.
  • Escalate significant risks, delays or issues to the relevant manager or leadership in a timely manner.

7. Quality Assurance and Project Completion

  • Coordinate reviews of project outputs and ensure feedback is incorporated before finalisation.
  • Evaluate project performance and assess whether intended outcomes and objectives have been achieved.
  • Lead project close-out, including final deliverables, reporting, financial reconciliation, documentation and lessons learned.
  • Capture and share lessons, good practice and recommendations to improve the delivery of future FESSIA projects.

8. Cross-Team and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Act as a central coordination point between Policy, Country, Finance and other FESSIA teams for assigned projects.
  • Support effective communication between internal teams, donors, consultants, partners and other project stakeholders.
  • Organize and coordinate project meetings, workshops and other activities as required.
  • Maintain clear communication on project progress, priorities, risks and required actions.


Desired to have:
● Understanding of energy systems, energy transition pathways, and regulatory structures.

● A second Asian language relevant to Southeast Asia.

● Master’s in Public Policy, Energy/Environmental Studies, Economics, International Relations, or related fields preferred.

title: Engineer Ecosystem Enablement
description:

As part of the IP QA team, you will play a critical role in qualifying and validating semiconductor IP libraries across various technology platforms. You will be responsible for assessing incoming vendor IP deliveries, executing IP quality assurance and PM-IP testing activities, and ensuring compatibility with evolving PDK and process updates. The role requires strong collaboration with external IP providers and internal development teams to resolve technical issues, enhance IP quality, and support successful customer deployment.

Essential Responsibilities include:

  • Perform incoming IP QA against a predefined QA checklist and meeting committed cycle time. This includes verifying the IP DK and Silicon deliverables against contract. To issue certificate of approval when QA has passed & certificate of non-conformance when QA has failed
  • To qualify IP merge kit to support customer tape-out
  • To maintain & timely update IP information in IP database and IP Catalog
  • Define comprehensive test case for IP qualification & IP regression
  • Continuous improvement in QA methodology and test case suite to ensure high quality of IP to support customer engagement & tape-out.
  • Assess and define IP Impact Assessment plan based on PDK update.
  • Perform IP Regression (Physical verification DRC/LVS/DFM, PEX extraction and Spice simulation) against predefined passing criteria and meeting committed cycle time.
  • Consolidation and review of IP Assessment results.
  • Chair meeting / review with all stakeholders on impact on the IP and drive to closure
  • Maintain and manage IP Regression Database
  • Support scripting and automation to improve work efficiency
  • Documentation of IP technical issues, waiver documents and assessment report.
  • Support customer queries and resolve technical issues related to IP
  • Maintain SOP workflow documentation and preparation for audit

Other Responsibilities:

  • Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs

Required Qualifications:

  • Education - Bachelor / Master Degree in Electrical, Electronics Engineering or equivalent.
  • Knowledge in RTL to GDS flow, Analog simulation
  • Proficient in layout design and drc/dfm/lvs debugging
  • Hands-on experience in industry standard CAD tools
  • Proficient in any scripting & automation languages
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Well organised and work well within a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with tools such as library compiler/Prime-time/VCS
  • Project management skills, i.e., the ability to innovate and execute on solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity.
  • Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making.

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard.

As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities.

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

title: 261000356 AI Engineer – Global Rates, APAC Local Markets Sales & Trading
description:
The Global Rates business is seeking an exceptional AI Engineer to support our APAC Local Markets rates Sales & Trading desk, driving the development and implementation of cutting-edge artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions that will transform our pricing, trading, risk management, and client service capabilities across the region's local rates markets. This role sits at the intersection of advanced AI/ML technology and financial markets, offering the opportunity to build innovative solutions that directly impact revenue generation, pricing precision, and trading risk management.

As an AI Engineer within Global Rates supporting APAC Local Markets, you will work directly alongside rates traders and sales professionals on the desk, translating fast-moving market needs into production-grade analytical tools. A core focus of the role is pricing optimization, bid-offer spread calibration, and the application of modern machine learning and generative AI techniques to sharpen client pricing and enhance trading risk management across local rates products. You will also be responsible for building the dashboards, visualizations, and alerting systems that empower sales and trading to detect shifts in client behavior, surface new sales opportunities, and pursue revenue optimization strategies.

Success in this role demands a proactive individual who is comfortable facing off directly to traders and sales people, thrives in a fast-paced trading floor environment, and can react quickly to changes in market needs.

Key Responsibilities

Pricing Optimization & Trading Analytics

  • Design, develop, and deploy models and tooling for pricing optimization and bid-offer spread calibration across APAC local rates products

  • Investigate and apply modern machine learning techniques to improve client pricing accuracy, competitiveness, and profitability

  • Build analytical solutions that strengthen trading risk management, including risk identification, hedging insight, and exposure monitoring

  • Partner with rates traders to rapidly prototype, test, and refine pricing and risk models in response to evolving market conditions

Dashboards, Visualization & Alerting

  • Build intuitive dashboards and visualizations for rates sales and trading to monitor client activity, pricing performance, and market dynamics

  • Develop alerting systems that flag changes in client behavior, emerging sales opportunities, and other revenue optimization signals

  • Translate complex data and model outputs into clear, actionable insights for a non-technical trading floor audience

  • Iterate quickly on tooling based on direct feedback from the desk

Generative AI & Machine Learning Solution Development

  • Design, develop, and deploy production-ready AI/ML applications leveraging generative AI techniques, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic frameworks

  • Apply generative AI to enhance trading workflows, client pricing insight, research summarization, and desk automation

  • Build intelligent automation to streamline repetitive trading and sales analytics tasks

  • Implement guardrails, validation frameworks, and monitoring for deployed AI/ML models and applications

Data Engineering & Integration

  • Design and build data pipelines to support analytics and ML workflows, integrating market data, trade data, and client activity data

  • Develop robust ETL processes for preparing model inputs and maintaining curated datasets

  • Leverage open-source frameworks such as Trino, Parquet, AWS S3, and Airflow to build scalable, high-performance data infrastructure

  • Create APIs and services to integrate analytics and AI capabilities into existing trading and sales platforms

Collaboration & Innovation

  • Partner directly with rates traders and sales people to identify high-impact use cases and deliver solutions at the speed the desk requires

  • Collaborate with quantitative researchers to integrate AI/ML techniques into rates pricing and risk models

  • Work with compliance and risk teams to ensure solutions meet regulatory and governance requirements

  • Stay current with emerging AI/ML technologies and evaluate their applicability to Global Rates and APAC Local Markets needs

  • Contribute to the firm's AI/ML community of practice and knowledge-sharing initiatives

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field

  • Strong academic foundation in algorithms, data structures, statistics, and software engineering principles

Professional Experience

  • 1–5 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, quantitative development, software development, or data science roles

  • Demonstrated experience building and deploying production analytical or AI applications

  • Proven track record of delivering end-to-end technical solutions, ideally in a fast-paced or front-office environment

Technical Skills – Core Requirements

Generative AI & Machine Learning:

  • Strong grounding in statistics and modern machine learning techniques, with the ability to apply ML to real-world problems such as pricing, forecasting, anomaly detection, or behavioral analysis

  • Hands-on experience with generative AI techniques and large language models (GPT, Claude, Llama, etc.)

  • Practical experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems

  • Experience with agentic frameworks and autonomous coding systems

Agentic Coding Tools:

  • Comfort and hands-on proficiency with agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., agentic IDEs and coding assistants) to accelerate delivery

  • Ability to effectively orchestrate, review, and validate AI-generated code within a production-grade engineering process

Programming & Development:

  • Strong proficiency in Python

  • Strong SQL skills

Front-End Architecture (Beneficial):

  • Solid knowledge of front-end architecture and modern web development, including JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and a modern component framework such as Angular or React

  • Ability to design and build responsive, performant, and maintainable user interfaces for dashboards, visualizations, and alerting tools used on the trading floor

  • Understanding of front-end architectural patterns — component-based design, state management, API/data integration, and reusable UI component libraries

  • Experience with data-visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Plotly, Chart.js, or equivalent) to present complex trading and client data clearly and interactively

  • Awareness of UX best practices for real-time, data-dense financial applications

Data & Open-Source Frameworks (Beneficial):

  • Knowledge of open-source data frameworks: Trino, Parquet, AWS S3, and Airflow

  • Experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines

Domain Knowledge

  • Knowledge of financial markets is a major plus — particularly rates Sales & Trading, APAC local rates products, pricing, and trading risk management

Key Attributes & Ways of Working

  • Proactive and self-directed — anticipates the needs of the desk and takes initiative

  • Comfortable facing off directly to traders and sales people — able to communicate clearly and credibly with front-office stakeholders

  • Fast and adaptable — reacts quickly to changing market needs and shifting priorities

  • Commercially minded — understands how technical solutions translate into revenue and risk outcomes

  • Collaborative — works effectively across trading, sales, quant, technology, and control functions

title: Project Manager, Office Relocation
company: Association of Women for Action And Research
description:
We are hiring! Project Manager, Office Relocation

AWARE is Singapore’s leading gender equality advocacy organisation. For nearly 40 years, we have worked to identify and eliminate gender barriers through research, advocacy, education, and support services, including the Sexual Assault Care Centre and Women’s Helpline.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and well-organised Project Manager with experience in office relocation, workplace/facilities projects, and renovation to facilitate AWARE's relocation from the current workplace at 5 Dover Crescent to the new premises at Race Course Road.

The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating and executing the office relocation from end to end, ensuring that the new premises are operationally ready, the physical move is completed safely and efficiently, and disruption to AWARE's employees and services is kept to a minimum.

The Project Manager will serve as the central point of coordination between AWARE, contractors, movers, IT vendors, building/property representatives and other external service providers.

Job Title: Project Manager, Office Relocation
Project: Relocation from 5 Dover Crescent to Race Course Road
Current Office: Approximately 3,000 sq ft
New Premises: Three-storey shophouse (Levels 2 and 3)
Contract Type: Fixed-term / Project-based contract (Part-time till end Feb, 2-3 days per week)
Reporting to: Executive Director / Designated AWARE Project Sponsor
Project Duration: To be confirmed based on relocation schedule
Salary: $3000-3900

Key Responsibilities

1. Overall Project Management

  • Develop and manage the complete office relocation project plan, including timeline, critical path, milestones, dependencies, responsibilities and budget.

  • Maintain a detailed project tracker and provide regular progress updates to the Executive Director and relevant stakeholders. Identify potential delays, risks and cost overruns early, with recommended solutions and escalation where required.

2. New Office Readiness

  • Coordinate with the relevant parties to ensure the Race Course Road premises are ready before relocation.

  • This includes monitoring readiness of the three floors, furniture, electrical works, lighting, air-conditioning, plumbing, security/access systems, signage, storage, meeting rooms and other workplace requirements.

  • Particular attention should be given to fire safety, occupancy and regulatory requirements associated with a multi-storey shophouse, with the appropriate qualified contractors or professionals responsible for technical and statutory compliance.

3. IT and Technology Coordination

  • Work with AWARE's IT provider or internal representative to coordinate relocation and commissioning of:

  • Internet and Wi-Fi, computers and peripherals, printers, telephones, meeting-room technology, network equipment, security/access systems and other essential technology.

  • Develop an IT cutover plan so that critical systems are tested and operational before employees commence work at the new office.

4. Move Planning and Logistics

  • Appoint and coordinate the moving company and establish a detailed move-day logistics plan.

  • Develop the packing schedule and labelling system, including identification by floor, room/function and owner at the new premises.

  • Coordinate movement of furniture, equipment, documents, archives and other AWARE assets.

  • Establish clear arrangements for confidential or sensitive materials so these are appropriately secured throughout packing, transportation and unpacking.

5. Staff Move Coordination and Communication

  • Develop clear instructions for employees covering what they need to pack, what will be packed by movers, packing deadlines, labelling requirements, personal belongings, confidential documents and Day 1 arrangements.

  • Act as the main contact for practical relocation questions and coordinate with designated representatives from different teams.

6. Asset Management, Disposal and Procurement

  • Conduct or coordinate an inventory of existing furniture, equipment and other assets and classify them as necessary to move, retain, dispose, donate, recycle, or replace

  • Coordinate disposal or donation where required and support procurement of additional furniture, equipment, storage and workplace items for the new office.

7. Vendor and Budget Management

  • Source quotations where required and coordinate vendors including movers, contractors, IT providers, cleaners, security/access providers, furniture suppliers, signage providers and disposal companies.

  • Maintain the approved relocation budget, track committed and actual expenditure, verify invoices against completed work and flag potential budget variances before commitments are made.

8. Move Day and Operational Readiness

  • Prepare a detailed Move Day Run Sheet identifying timing, vendor arrival, loading sequence, transport, unloading, floor-by-floor placement and responsible persons.

  • Be physically present during the move to coordinate vendors and resolve operational issues.

  • Before staff return, conduct a Day 1 Readiness Check covering essential systems, workspaces, Wi-Fi, phones, printers, meeting rooms, access, safety, pantry facilities and other critical workplace requirements.

9. Existing Office Handover

  • Coordinate clearance of the Dover Crescent office after the move, including removal of remaining assets, cleaning, disposal and any landlord reinstatement obligations.

  • Support the final inspection and handover of the premises and ensure outstanding matters are documented and closed.

10. Project Closure

  • Maintain a relocation snag list after occupation and ensure outstanding defects or incomplete works are followed through to closure.

  • Complete final reconciliation of the project budget, vendor invoices, documentation and outstanding actions.

  • Provide a short project closure report covering costs, unresolved issues and recommendations.

Experience and Skills

The ideal candidate should have experience in office relocation, workplace/facilities projects, renovation or fit-out coordination, operations or project management.

Strong organisational and vendor-management capability is essential, together with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.

The individual should be practical and hands-on, comfortable being on-site, able to anticipate problems before they become critical, and confident coordinating contractors and stakeholders.

Strong attention to detail, budgeting and documentation skills are required.

Experience managing an office move involving multiple floors, shophouses or older buildings would be advantageous.

Desired Outcome of Project

The project will be considered successful when

  1. The Race Course Road office is safe, operational and ready for employees on the agreed date,

  2. The physical relocation is completed with minimal disruption,

  3. Critical IT and workplace systems are operational,

  4. Assets and confidential materials are accounted for,

  5. The project remains within the approved budget,

  6. The Dover Crescent premises are handed back according to the agreed requirements.

title: Head of B2C (wymagany ekspercki poziom vibe codingu)
description:
O nas i o roli

Telemedi to jeden z liderów assistance w sektorze zdrowia w Polsce. Działamy na dużą skalę: ponad milion spraw rocznie, realni pacjenci, realne problemy.

B2C to ta część firmy, w której pacjent płaci z własnej kieszeni: wizyty lekarskie, abonamenty, plany medyczne, badania laboratoryjne, diagnostyka. Szukamy osoby, która weźmie całe B2C na siebie: ofertę, ceny, sprzedaż i wynik.

Zaczynamy od warunku koniecznego. To rola dla kogoś, kto buduje z AI na poziomie eksperckim. Landing page, lejek, eksperyment, dashboard czy automatyzację robisz sam(a), a nie zamawiasz.

Co będziesz robić

• Odpowiadasz za wynik całego B2C: przychód, marżę i budżet. Sprzedajesz out of pocket: wizyty lekarskie, abonamenty, plany medyczne, badania laboratoryjne i diagnostykę.

• Decydujesz o ofercie i cenach: co sprzedajemy, komu i za ile. Na podstawie kohort, nie przeczucia.

• Monitorujesz kohorty: kto kupił, kto wrócił, kto odpadł i w którym miejscu. To Twój podstawowy widok na biznes.

• Budujesz customer loop: pierwsza wizyta, kolejny zakup, abonament. Pacjent ma wracać, a nie być kupowany od nowa.

• Pracujesz w pętli: hipoteza, prototyp, wdrożenie, pomiar, poprawka. Cały czas, a nie raz na kwartał.

• Sam(a) budujesz z AI to, czego potrzebujesz: landing page’e, lejki, eksperymenty, narzędzia wewnętrzne, dashboardy.

• Decyzje podejmujesz na danych. „Wydaje mi się” i „zawsze tak robiliśmy” nie są u nas argumentem.

• Wprowadzasz nowe produkty B2C, od testu popytu po skalowanie.

Requirements

Czego szukamy

• Eksperckiego poziomu pracy z AI i vibe codingu. Pokaż nam rzeczy, które zbudowałaś/zbudowałeś i które działają: strony, narzędzia, automatyzacje, dashboardy. Na rozmowie zapytamy o konkrety, a na assessment day zobaczymy, jak pracujesz. To warunek konieczny.

• Doświadczenia w prowadzeniu B2C lub e-commerce z odpowiedzialnością za wynik, a nie tylko za kanał czy kampanie. Chcemy usłyszeć o decyzjach, które podjęłaś/podjąłeś, i o tym, co pokazały liczby.

• Doświadczenia w sprzedaży online do klienta indywidualnego: e-commerce, subskrypcje, aplikacje konsumenckie. Rozumiesz lejek, retencję i ekonomię klienta, bo liczyłaś/liczyłeś je na własnych danych.

• Myślenia kohortami. Średnia z całego miesiąca Cię nie uspokaja, dopóki nie wiesz, co się pod nią kryje.

• Ekstremalnej sprawczości. Chcemy zobaczyć rzeczy, które uruchomiłaś/uruchomiłeś od zera, a nie projekty, w których „brałaś/brałeś udział”.

• Umiejętności policzenia własnego biznesu, bez czekania na kontroling.

Mile widziane

• Doświadczenie w healthtechu lub usługach medycznych. Jest plusem, ale nie warunkiem. Ważniejsze, żebyś umiał(a) samodzielnie wejść w nowy obszar.

Jak pracujemy

Krótkie ścieżki decyzyjne: raportujesz bezpośrednio do zarządu. Bez komitetów, które przez kwartał ustalają, kto zatwierdza zmianę na stronie. Zamiast tego własność tematu i oczekiwanie, że efekty będą widoczne w liczbach. Codziennie pokazujemy sobie postępy i upewniamy się, że robimy rzeczy najważniejsze dla całej firmy.

AI jest u nas podstawowym narzędziem pracy, nie dodatkiem. Masz do niego pełny dostęp i oczekujemy, że będziesz z niego korzystać codziennie.

Warszawa, praca hybrydowa.

Umowa zlecenie lub B2B, jak wolisz.

Proces rekrutacji

1. Zadanie do zrobienia.

2. Rozmowa i prezentacja zadania, 45 minut.

3. Rozmowa o kulturze pracy, 30 minut. Sprawdzamy, na ile się zgrywamy.

4. Assessment day: 3–4 godziny u nas w biurze. Na koniec omówienie i feedback, niezależnie od decyzji. Pokrywamy koszt dojazdu.

Odzywamy się do wybranych kandydatów.

title: System Development Engineer , Managed Operations
description:
AWS has successfully launched the European Sovereign Cloud (ESC), marking a significant development in Utility Computing (UC). To spearhead this initiative, we are actively seeking experienced system development engineers with a strong background in automation and operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/

Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in "on-call" rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.

The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best-in-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.

Utility Computing (UC)
European Sovereign Cloud (ESC) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC).
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Managed Operations engineers engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.


Eligibility requirement
-Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
-Candidate must be a national of an EU member state and residing in the EU to operate the AWS European Sovereign Cloud.
-Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the European Union.
-Employees will participate in an On-Call rota.



A day in the life
A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You’ll spend roughly 50% of your time operating production systems and 50% working with your team to make long-term improvements to the reliability, availability, and performance of those software systems. Over the course of a week, you will root cause why some deployments recently failed, and fix those bugs. Later in the week you may execute a highly sensitive time-critical change to production. You can round off the week by participating in design discussions by another team, writing code, and providing actionable feedback to your team’s code. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
